kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse create-backup-policy --db-cluster-id cc-bp108z124a8o70000 --preferred-backup-time 10:00Z-11:00Z --preferred-backup-period Monday,Friday --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The backup time in UTC. The format is HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ.

Example: 00:00Z-01:00Z. This means that data backup can be performed from 00:00 to 01:00 UTC (08:00 to 09:00 UTC+8)
parameters.help_zh:
备份时间，UTC时间。格式：HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ。

示例：00:00Z-01:00Z，表示UTC时间的0点到1点（即北京时间的8点到9点）可进行数据备份
parameters.name: preferred_backup_time

parameters.help_en:
The backup cycle. If you specify multiple days, separate them with commas. Valid values:

Monday

Tuesday

Wednesday

Thursday

Friday

Saturday

Sunday
parameters.help_zh:
备份周期。如果有多个，请用“,”隔开。取值说明：
Monday：周一。
Tuesday：周二。
Wednesday：周三。
Thursday：周四。
Friday：周五。
Saturday：周六。
Sunday：周日
parameters.name: preferred_backup_period

parameters.help_en: The backup retention period in days. The value must be an integer from 7 to 730. The default value is 7
parameters.help_zh: 备份保留时间，默认保留时间为7天。取值范围：7~730。单位：天
parameters.name: backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
